sloka: दशरथसुतराक्षसेन्द्रयोर्जयमनवेक्ष्य रणे स राघवस्य ।सुरवररथसारथिर्महान् रणगतमेनमुवाच वाक्यमाशु ।। ६.११०.३९ ।।
transliteration: daśarathasutarākṣasendrayorjayamanavekṣya raṇe sa rāghavasya ।suravararathasārathirmahān raṇagatamenamuvāca vākyamāśu ।। 6.110.39 ।।

translations.english: The fight between Rama and Ravana continued all day and night, without stopping for a moment.
